description: Held-out ticket continuations after a verified account creation. Each case renders the verified-account message the live worker sends; a proposal passes only with the bound project and a summary naming the verified user_id or email. Names, accounts, projects and request shapes are absent from training (enforced by a unit test).

cases.name: continuation live onboarding wording
cases.user: Create a corporate account for given name Yusuf, family name Demir, department Procurement and role Buyer. After the account is successfully created, create a Jira ticket in project SUP for that created account, then notify me by email.
